newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Goldman Sachs cuts Danish 97 c/a estimate.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Goldman Sachs cuts Danish 97 c/a estimate.

text.p: In its latest survey Goldman Sachs on Thursday lowered its expectations for Denmark's 1997 current account surplus to 3.8 billion crowns from 10.7 billion crowns in its last forecast in January.
At the same time it left unchanged its previous estimates of 3.5 percent GDP (gross domestic product) growth and 2.6 percent inflation this year unchanged.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in December foresaw 2.9 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 8.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 13.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
